hints.title: Expand before differentiating
hints.body: Expand (1−3x)2, then divide every resulting term by 2x32.
hints.recap: A squared numerator over a power becomes a sum of powers after expansion.
hints.pitfall: The middle term of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></math>.
hints.pause: Write the three terms in power form.

recall.reminder: A squared numerator over a power becomes a sum of powers after expansion.

hints.title: Apply the power rule
hints.body: The simplified expression is 12x−32−3x−12+(92)x12. Differentiate each term independently.
hints.recap: Multiply each coefficient by its exponent and reduce the exponent by one.
hints.pitfall: The negative coefficient multiplied by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></math> gives a positive term.
hints.pause: Compute the derivative without reordering its terms yet.

recall.reminder: Multiply each coefficient by its exponent and reduce the exponent by one.

hints.title: Compare signs carefully
hints.body: The new exponents are −52, −32 and −12. The options list the terms in the opposite order.
hints.recap: Reordering a sum does not change any coefficient or sign.
hints.pitfall: Matching only the exponents will not distinguish these options.
hints.pause: Read the coefficient signs in the order <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mtext> </mtext><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mtext> </mtext><mfrac><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></math>.

recall.reminder: Reordering a sum does not change any coefficient or sign.

solution:
Expand and simplify: y=1−6x+9x22x32=12x−32−3x−12+(92)x12.

Termwise differentiation gives y′=−(34)x−52+(32)x−32+(94)x−12. In the order used by the choices this is (94)x−12+(32)x−32−(34)x−52, option A.
